state.title: Export loses accented characters
state.body: CSV export changes customer names with accents to question marks. It occurs for all exports, but the original records remain intact.

category.instructions: Classify the GitHub issue by its primary intent.

impact.instructions: Rate the reported user impact, using only the evidence supplied.
criteria: Cosmetic inconvenience with no affected data or workflow
A workflow produces incorrect output but original data remains available
Core operation unavailable or original data permanently lost
